sentences.en: Parrots are the only animal that can imitate human speech.
sentences.zh: 鹦鹉是唯一能模仿人类说话的声音的动物。

sentences.en: I can't understand how can you imitate him so exactly.
sentences.zh: 我实在不明白你怎么能模仿他那么像。

sentences.en: Life imitates art more often than the other way around.
sentences.zh: 通常生活中的事物会模仿艺术，而不是反过来。

senses.zh: 模仿, 仿效, 模仿（某人的讲话、举止）, 作滑稽模仿
